instruction: Replace PR #151 per-product manufacturer-wide web search and its top-four-link limit with an official NITE SAFE-Lite government recall corpus. Collect all paginated official listings, obtain every corresponding official notice with resumable, fail-closed backfill, and compare ALL six selected products and ALL published products daily. Keep recall candidates on hold for serial/date scope verification, and expose directly linked manufacturer notice only after an official government recall match. Preserve existing independent Article Safety QA, CEO approval, publication controls and all other product rules.
